# admin_system — Plugify C++ plugin: administration core (admins, groups, permissions,
# punishments, admin menu) and the IAdminApi replacement for the Pisex modules.
#
#   admin_core            engine-independent core (also used by tests/admin_core_tests.cpp)
#   admin_system_bindings binding globals (__admin_system_*) generated by bin/plugify-gen,
#                         compiled into the plugin like s2sdk_bindings / permissions_bindings
#   plugify-admin_system  the plugin shared library (entry "bin/admin_system")
#
# The consumer side of the API (plugins/admin_system/include) is generated from
# admin_system.pplugin by bin/plugify-gen; see API.md.

set(ADMIN_SYSTEM_VERSION "1.0.0")

# --- generated consumer bindings ----------------------------------------------
# The .pplugin for the generator needs the version substituted at configure time.
set(ADMIN_SYSTEM_PPLUGIN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/admin_system.pplugin")
configure_file(
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/admin_system.pplugin.in"
        "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_PPLUGIN}"
)

# plugify-gen writes <output>/external/plugify/include/<name>/..., the same layout the
# cookies plugin uses; include/external/plugify/include is therefore the include root of the
# generated consumer API and include/admin_api.hpp (hand written) sits next to it.
set(ADMIN_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/external/plugify/include")
set(ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_CPP "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_ROOT}/admin_system/admin_system.cpp")

# Refreshes the bindings with the current manifest. Best effort by design: the generated
# headers are checked in and are the source of truth for compilation, so a host without the
# generator keeps building (the checked-in files stay untouched).
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin/plugify-gen")
    add_custom_command(
            OUTPUT "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_CPP}"
            COMMAND sh -c "'${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin/plugify-gen' -manifest '${ADMIN_SYSTEM_PPLUGIN}' -output '${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include' -lang cpp -overwrite || { echo 'plugify-gen failed (ignored, keeping the checked-in bindings)'; touch '${ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_CPP}'; }"
            DEPENDS "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_PPLUGIN}"
            COMMENT "plugify-gen: admin_system bindings"
            VERBATIM
    )
    add_custom_target(admin_system_bindings ALL
            DEPENDS "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_CPP}")
else()
    add_custom_target(admin_system_bindings ALL
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "bin/plugify-gen not found: keeping the checked-in admin_system bindings")
endif()

# The generated binding globals are third-party code: no -Werror on them.
set(ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_OBJECTS "")
if(EXISTS "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_CPP}")
    add_library(admin_system_bindings_obj OBJECT "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_CPP}")
    target_include_directories(admin_system_bindings_obj SYSTEM PUBLIC "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_ROOT}")
    target_include_directories(admin_system_bindings_obj SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include")
    target_compile_definitions(admin_system_bindings_obj PUBLIC _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1)
    add_dependencies(admin_system_bindings_obj admin_system_bindings)
    set(ADMIN_SYSTEM_BINDINGS_OBJECTS "$<TARGET_OBJECTS:admin_system_bindings_obj>")
endif()

# --- core ---------------------------------------------------------------------
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/admin_core.cpp")
    add_library(admin_core STATIC src/admin_core.cpp)
    target_include_directories(admin_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
    target_link_libraries(admin_core PUBLIC plgdb)
    target_compile_options(admin_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    target_compile_definitions(admin_core PUBLIC _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1)
endif()

# --- plugin -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Phase 2 (the s2sdk/pisexcompat glue) adds src/plugin.cpp; until then only admin_core and
# the generated bindings are built. The plugin *implements* the API directly on admin_core and
# never calls the generated binding slots (those belong to the consumer side, filled by the
# plugify module inside each module plugin), so only the s2sdk bindings are linked in here.
if(TARGET admin_core AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/plugin.cpp")
    add_library(plugify-admin_system SHARED
            src/plugin.cpp
            src/commands.cpp
            src/menus.cpp
            $<TARGET_OBJECTS:s2sdk_bindings>
    )
    target_include_directories(plugify-admin_system PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
    # SYSTEM: warnings from the generated s2sdk/plg/permissions/pisexcompat headers must not fail
    # -Werror on our sources.
    target_include_directories(plugify-admin_system SYSTEM PRIVATE
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/pisexcompat/include")
    # The generated consumer headers of our own plugin: only the callback typedefs of
    # admin_system/delegates.hpp are used (the binding slots stay null in the producer).
    target_include_directories(plugify-admin_system SYSTEM PRIVATE "${ADMIN_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_ROOT}")
    target_link_libraries(plugify-admin_system PRIVATE
            admin_core
            pisexcompat
            -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
    )
    target_compile_options(plugify-admin_system PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    target_compile_definitions(plugify-admin_system PRIVATE
            _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1
            PLUGIFY_MODULE="admin_system"
            PLUGIFY_IS_DEBUG=0
            PLUGIFY_IS_RELEASE=1
    )
    set_target_properties(plugify-admin_system PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME admin_system)

    if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
        target_link_options(plugify-admin_system PRIVATE
                "-Wl,--version-script,${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sym/version_script.lds")
    endif()
endif()
